mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned gold project ~50 km north of Meekatharra, WA, on granted mining leases. Open-pit and underground mining feeding a central processing plant (upgraded June 2025: larger 750 kW ball mill, additional leach/adsorption tanks, residence time 11->21 hrs). First gold poured 1 July 2025 (gravity circuit); plant ramp-up through FY2026. Open-pit mining concluded July 2026 after contractor productivity fell short, delaying access to higher-grade ore; ~300,000 oz of open-pit resource remains in-ground. Operation shifting to higher-grade underground ore: Andy Well underground (owner-operator model; 1,503 m development, 23 kt ore in H1 FY2026) and Turnberry (preparations advanced; Turnberry Central and South pits feeding plant in June 2026 quarter). Mineral Resource expanded to ~1.5 Moz @ 2.8 g/t after FY2026 discoveries (incl. Rosapenna target: 23 m @ 1.05 g/t) and acquisitions.
